notes.title: CPM 2 Free to play UPDATE
notes.content:
good day
Since some games do not understand we have our game concept.
Would like to explain this here briefly.
CPM2 is fundamentally free and touchable for everyone. And anyone who would like to have more of the game can buy the DELUXE DLC for a small sum and get more. With the purchase of the DLC you support the developers. But all DLC are not required.

[b]We are sorry if it came to misunderstandings.[/b]


[i]Because some customers have complained about the advertising. Have we brought out an update and designed the advertising a little less aggressive.


[/i]
[b]We thank you for your understanding and wish you a lot of fun.[/b]
